harper: Postmortem follow-up: recurring overnight model-load spikes produced short 503 windows (~2-4m). We need a one-page runbook + tiny triage tool. Two-week target to ship and rehearse.

harper: Action sketch (short):
- Runbook: prescriptive 0/3/10 minute escalation ladder + exact commands. owner: mina. due: 2024-12-07
- Triage script `mini-load-triage.sh`: health, metrics p50/p95, error-rate, quick logs. owner: zack. due: 2024-12-07
- Cron warmup: K8s CronJob at 23:50 to pre-load model. owner: infra. due: 2024-12-11
- Fallback route: circuit to standby variant on load failure. owner: harper. due: 2024-12-15
- CI smoke: 5 sanity requests, mean <300ms. owner: mina + eng-sre. due: 2024-12-15

harper: Minimal triage one-liners to include in script (do not hardcode secrets):
curl -fsS https://api.redwood-infer/health || echo "health FAIL"
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency_p50" -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_KEY" | jq .
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency_p95" -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_KEY" | jq .
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=request_error_rate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_KEY" | jq .
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=200 | sed -n '1,200p'

zack: I'll own the triage script. Plan: `--quick` mode (health + p50 + error-rate) and `--full` mode (adds p95 + logs). Script will read METRICS_KEY from env or prompt, `--dry-run` flag available. Won't store tokens.

mina: I'll draft the compact runbook: top-of-doc short checklist with exact commands + escalation phone matrix in a vault link. Appendix will have deeper diagnostics and safe-restart guidance. I'll create `docs/playbooks/model-load-compact.md` and reference JIRA epic RINF-700.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-415 created and linked.

pagerduty-bot: Tabletop rehearsal scheduled: 2024-12-06 16:00 UTC.

harper: Please link PRs to RINF-700. I'll gate playbook review until triage script and cronjob PRs are linked. After PRs land we'll run the tabletop with an on-call engineer and collect friction notes. Keep language action-first at the top.

zack: I'll post a first-pass gist by tomorrow EOD.

mina: Will open runbook PR Monday and include the escalation ladder (0m channel, 3m page eng-sre, 10m page infra + manager).

harper: Thanks. Short and prescriptive is the goal. If any task looks like it needs automation beyond simple scripts, make a follow-up ticket rather than bloating the playbook.

zack: :thumbsup:
